text:
Nora (Marketing): short brief for launch next Tue — need a mini 'serving econ' visual kit: hero banner, webinar frame, and 1:1 social gif. Priority: credibility-forward + ad-ready sizes.
Dex (Design): got it. deliverables and specs?
Nora (Marketing): deliverables: 1) hero banner 1200x628 (email + social) 2) webinar frame 1920x1080 (title-safe 150px, CTA-safe 220px) 3) social gif 1:1 1080x1080 (~3s loop, animated CTA pulse) 4) updated 16:9 slide template (editable metric pills). Provide logo-left and logo-centered variants.
Camille (Creative Ops): tagging L10n and Legal. Need Figma source, export tokens, and placeholders for EN/FR/DE. Leave extra width for DE copy.
ExportBot: checklist added — PNG @2x, SVG icons, GIF optimized via gifsicle. Accessibility: contrast >=4.5:1; include alt text; visible focus state on CTA.
Mateo (Growth): CTA variants for A/B: "See the numbers" and "Register — seats limited". Provide two caption options and a short 60-char email tagline. We'll run social ads with the 1:1 gif.
Dex (Design): style direction? illustrative or data-forward?
Nora (Marketing): data-forward preferred (sparklines + metric pills) but include a subtle illustrative accent (single mascot or badge). Keep tone professional.
Dex (Design): timeline: initial mock Thu EOD, review Fri, final Monday AM PST. GIF: 3-frame loop at 12fps, CTA pulse on frame 2. Will upload WIP to Figma and tag for review.
Camille (Creative Ops): L10n note — provide copy slots and mark where translations go. Legal: any numeric claims must reference bench-run-0706 and include a 12px methodology footnote.
LegalBot: noted. will review final assets. if numbers are preliminary use relative language ("up to" / "typical").
Dex (Design): export snippet to include in file:```
PNG: export @2x
SVG: outline strokes
GIF: gifsicle --optimize=3 --colors 128
```
Mateo (Growth): social constraints — 1:1 gif max 600kb; 16:9 max 800kb. Please supply both logo-left and centered variants for ad tests.
Nora (Marketing): messaging drafts: A: "Serving wins: benchmarked cost × latency" B: "Predictable inference economics for product teams" Use A on technical channels, B for product/social.
Dex (Design): will include both headline treatments and a footnote area for methodology. uploading WIP now: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-econ-mini-kit — frames named "hero-v1", "webinar-frame-v1", "gif-variants".
Camille (Creative Ops): once WIP uploaded I'll trigger legal and L10n reviews and prepare export checklist. If any accessibility issues, flag here.
Nora (Marketing): thank you — review Fri 11am PST. escalate blockers here. :thumbsup:
